project.title: Coming of Age across Latin America and the Latinx U.S.
project.description: This teaching project explores coming-of-age narratives across Latin America and the Latinx U.S. Through annotated audiovisual materials, students will examine how gender, family, migration, and social expectations shape experiences of growing up. The project connects close analysis of image, sound, and language with literary readings and contextual research.
